scope: Independent algebra, source-extraction and point-membership checks on retrospective data; no fresh accuracy observations.

exactGlobalFactors.method: Rebuilt each source-line polygon projection with affine_envelope; independently split each horizon/envelope band at pairwise affine crossings; clipped A,D by open physical bounds; took rational endpoint limits of A_low/D_high and A_high/D_low; evaluated every included temporal knot with public affine_value. Does not import evaluate.py, joint_space.py, or their ratio-splitting functions.

intervalReview.limitations: Synthetic checks verify interval/envelope machinery. The driver report replays existing projections and exact point oracles; neither retrospective report establishes institutional rule correctness or prediction accuracy.

driverStaticReview.integerHorizonKnots: horizon(rows,t) evaluates the row at floor(t) and the following row; all requested windows are interior to the supplied calendar rows.
driverStaticReview.emptyStatuses: sourceLineStatus is retained per event and trim; point APIs retain public interval statuses; infeasible sets normalize to empty unions without dropping the separately stored source status.
driverStaticReview.inclusion: The driver checks free-q fixed-k membership against an independent point oracle at knots, quarter-day probes, piece midpoints, and near feasible interval endpoints; replays 588 old integer factor projections and old fixed-q feasible intervals.
driverStaticReview.interpretation: possibleFactors intersects per-case existential projections and is explicitly labeled as allowing distinct per-case anchors/quotients; commonDisplacementAt18Over16 is a separate shared-displacement test.
driverStaticReview.limitations: Driver report checks and supplemental quotient serialization have now run and were independently verified.
driverStaticReview.supplementalCorrection: Initial serialization gap resolved by export_samples.py; 2,542 rational t/k/q records independently match exact recomputation.

driverReportReview.conclusion: Static review found correct separation of per-case factor projections from common displacement. Existing report invariants and empty tie status are preserved. Coupled q intervals are stored at knots and original anchors and represented algebraically per open piece; sampled non-knot q intervals were validated but not serialized as separate records.
driverReportReview.pendingPlanWording: Plan states coupled q interval at sampled t; code verifies q at many samples but stores only selected q records. Add samples to report or narrow frozen plan wording.
driverReportReview.limitations: Driver report and supplemental q serialization independently checked; synthetic tests remain supplemental coverage, not institutional accuracy validation.

supplementalQuotients.result: All q interval statuses, rational bounds, and endpoint flags match independent affine_value/quotient_interval recomputation.

correction.initialReviewGap: Driver initially serialized q intervals at knots/original anchor and only checked non-knot sample witnesses.
correction.resolution: export_samples.py added supplemental sampled-joint-quotients.json bound by the unchanged report SHA256; independently recomputed all 2,542 records exactly.
correction.countClarification: Persisted rerunnable review checks contain 196 distinct constant-band/closure cases (not 1,764), 61,370 varying-band quotient samples, four union topology assertions, and 256 envelope differential datasets.

boundaryReview.method: Independent exact Fraction intersection of slope inequalities at recomputed physical root, from archived quantized cells with half-open minute bins [u−1/2,u+1/2). Floats become exact binary rationals. No stored root or score flags used for calculation.

finalPublicationReview.finding: No material corrections. Counts, exact open factor interval, trimming results, and no-gap accounting match private reports; distinct case anchors/quotients are not presented as a transferable formula. Four public helper/test files match private copies byte for byte.
